resources.file_path:
--- PAGE 5: PROCESS SCHEDULING ---
CPU scheduling is the basis of multiprogrammed operating systems. By switching the CPU among processes, the operating system makes the computer more productive. The ready queue holds all processes residing in main memory that are ready and waiting to execute.
